habits.boundary_condition: This is a soft longitudinal default, not proof of an exact 4-star-only requirement. If both hotel-class stars and customer-review ratings are available, clarify the metric or apply the 4-star floor to the metric being discussed.
habits.condition: Use during hotel searches when a rating, review score, or hotel star-quality filter is available.
habits.default_action: Filter or prioritize hotel options that meet a 4-star minimum before presenting recommendations, and report the rating source when known.
habits.exception_condition: If no suitable hotel meets the 4-star floor while satisfying more important trip constraints, ask before relaxing the rating threshold.
habits.name: hotel_four_star_quality_floor
habits.preference_value: Prefer hotels with a 4-star-or-better quality threshold; when using Google/customer ratings, target at least 4.0 stars.
habits.rationale: All three independent hotel conversations include the user setting a 4-star quality threshold. Two explicitly name Google/customer ratings, while the third gives 4 stars when asked for a star preference, supporting a reusable 4-star hotel-quality default.
